title: MV Multi Sample "Text Sound Effect" Plugin Request

posts.author: III
posts.body:
Hello, I’m not looking for the kind of SE text plugin where it has 1 sample that it plays every time a glyph is printed. I am looking for a plugin that allows you to create sets where you can put in multiple samples, and then when words begin printing for a specific instance it cycles through the samples to create something more sonically dynamic and more illustrative of the characters actual voice.

Are you offering to re-write KC_TextSounds to fit this plugin idea or to fix the code I sent with a randomized play function that actually works? Referring to KC, it would be much more breezy to have an endless amount of sound effects that can be put in an individual preset. If you are actually offering to fix my bastardized GALV code then that is good too, I would just like for this idea to be manifested in some way. Apologies for asking, I just want to get full clarification.
A sample being played Per Word is probably a lot better than per letter, as I can imagine ‘per glyph’ may sound overwhelming. An option to switch between ‘per letter’ or ‘per word’ would be convenient if plausible. The entire plugin's function is to randomly play an SE per word printed, so it being an ‘option’ doesn’t make sense to me.

For what it's worth, those examples are not doing what you describe. They aren't dynamically-generated sounds, they're actual, pre-recorded audio files that are played for each message.
You can do that by manipulating public domain audio like the creators of that game did and putting a Play SE event command in front of each Show Text line.
